narrative: The model estimated a 58% probability that you would be a bad credit risk, meaning the application was denied because the assessed risk was above the bank’s acceptance level. To improve a future application, focus on bringing your checking account into positive standing, shortening the requested term if possible, and strengthening your credit record.
